pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/42831
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/34858

Question:
* We need to pass TLS configuration information from Kestrel to Quic transport. The PR is setting a delegate that returns an `SslServerAuthenticationOptions` and an `IList<SslApplicationProtocol>` on a feature collection. Should a new type be added to the connection abstractions project for sharing this information? Delegates and lists in a feature collection feels a bit hacky. e.g. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/06a1f45f79c300c732b0171ce6318a130d05a083/src/Servers/Kestrel/Core/src/TlsHandshakeCallbackOptions.cs
* Should the delegate take a context object in case we need to add new values in the future? e.g. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/06a1f45f79c300c732b0171ce6318a130d05a083/src/Servers/Kestrel/Core/src/TlsHandshakeCallbackContext.cs

(can't use these `TlsHandshakeCallbackOptions` or `TlsHandshakeCallbackContext` because they're in Kestrel and Quic transport doesn't have a dependency)

Thanks!
